name: foldling_fish
notes: Floats: belly 1 cm above the table; the origin stays on the table top.

name: paper_bird
notes: Flying form after a correct answer. Origin at the body centre; flies towards +x.

name: flag_small
notes: Origin at the foot of the pole; attach to a Foldling flag_anchor. Plain cream cloth, the game draws the number at label_anchor.

name: popup_book
notes: Open flat. spawn_anchor: centre of the left page; town_origin: centre of the right page; exit_anchor: 6 cm above the spine. page_hinge_* hold the top leaf (rotate about z to turn a page).

name: popup_book_closed
notes: Spine on the -x side; cover_front opens about z at its spine edge.

name: page_popup_frame
notes: Panels hinge on their bottom edge: rotate about x from -90 (flat) to 0 (upright, rest pose). Place at the back of the open book.

name: crystal
notes: Long paper gem. Neutral lavender; the game recolours the lavender materials. Origin at the centre.

name: crystal_2
notes: Paper gem: hexagonal prism with pointed caps. Neutral lavender; the game recolours it. Origin at the centre.

name: crystal_3
notes: Short fat paper gem. Neutral lavender; the game recolours it. Origin at the centre.

name: orb
notes: Origin at the centre.

name: crystal_tray
notes: slot_0..4 sit 0.09 m apart on the seat tops.

name: balloon_round
notes: Paper-cut hot-air balloon. Origin at the bottom of the basket. Gores alternate sky/sky_shade and blue/blue_shade; the game recolours both pairs.

name: balloon_long
notes: Paper-cut hot-air balloon. Origin at the bottom of the basket.

name: balloon_heart
notes: Paper-cut hot-air balloon. Origin at the bottom of the basket.

name: balloon_pop_pieces
notes: Each piece_N has its origin at its own centre, laid out in a ring for the burst effect.

name: conveyor_straight
notes: Tiles end to end along x (0.12 m pitch). Belt top at y = 0.028.

name: conveyor_start
notes: Its belt end at x = +0.04 joins a conveyor_straight whose centre is at x = +0.1.

name: sort_gate
notes: Stands across the belt (items travel along x). Gates 1 to 3 in coral, cobalt, sunflower.

name: item_token
notes: A flat folded paper envelope. Origin at the centre; the flap points at -z, the label sits on the bottom fold.

name: gap_cliffs
notes: Gap 0.24 m = one bridge unit, between the two sockets.

name: plank_1
notes: Exactly 240.0 mm long (1/1 of the 0.24 m unit). Origin at the centre. No ink outline so the length reads exactly.

name: plank_1_2
notes: Exactly 120.0 mm long (1/2 of the 0.24 m unit). Origin at the centre. No ink outline so the length reads exactly.

name: plank_1_3
notes: Exactly 80.0 mm long (1/3 of the 0.24 m unit). Origin at the centre. No ink outline so the length reads exactly.

name: plank_1_4
notes: Exactly 60.0 mm long (1/4 of the 0.24 m unit). Origin at the centre. No ink outline so the length reads exactly.

name: plank_1_5
notes: Exactly 48.0 mm long (1/5 of the 0.24 m unit). Origin at the centre. No ink outline so the length reads exactly.

name: plank_1_6
notes: Exactly 40.0 mm long (1/6 of the 0.24 m unit). Origin at the centre. No ink outline so the length reads exactly.

name: plank_1_8
notes: Exactly 30.0 mm long (1/8 of the 0.24 m unit). Origin at the centre. No ink outline so the length reads exactly.

name: plank_1_10
notes: Exactly 24.0 mm long (1/10 of the 0.24 m unit). Origin at the centre. No ink outline so the length reads exactly.

name: scale
notes: Rotate beam about z (0 to 20 degrees); rotate pan_left/pan_right by the opposite angle so the pans hang level.

name: weight_block
notes: Origin at the bottom centre; stacks every 0.03 m (safe up to 4).

name: gate
notes: Doors hinge at their outer edges: rotate door_left by +y, door_right by -y to open.

name: tape_measure
notes: tape is 1 m long at scale x = 1 (rest scale 0.02). Keep tape_end at x = 0.025 + 1.0 * scale. Marks every 5 cm (long at 10 cm), no numbers.

name: ruler_30
notes: 0 to 30 cm scale (marks every 5 mm, longer at 1 cm and 5 cm, exact spacing) on a 0.31 m board. mm marks omitted: they would be thinner than the 2 mm minimum. Origin at the centre = 15 cm mark.

name: marker_pin
notes: Point A coral (base file), point B cobalt (_b).

name: treasure_chest
notes: lid hinges at the back top edge: rotate about x (negative opens).

name: origami_shark
notes: The long upper tail lobe is the thresher shark's signature.

name: origami_chameleon
notes: Sits on a bark branch (one flat colour, the sixth material).

name: origami_hummingbird
notes: Hovers: the body floats 2.6 cm above the table; the origin stays on the table top. Clip flap.

name: origami_swallow
notes: Hovers: the body floats 2.6 cm above the table; the origin stays on the table top. Clip flap.

name: base10_unit
notes: Origin at the bottom centre. All base-10 blocks share this 10 mm unit.

name: base10_rod
notes: Ten 10 mm cubes along x; shaded creases mark each cube.

name: base10_flat
notes: Ten rods side by side with unit creases across.

name: number_line
notes: tick_0..10 every 0.028 m (longer at 0, 5, 10); label_anchor_N just in front of each tick. Ends are plain so lines can be chained.

name: bar_strip
notes: Origin at the left end: scale x to cut it (1 = the whole unit, 0.24 m).

name: area_grid
notes: 10 x 10 cells of 15 mm. cell_origin = centre of the -x/-z corner cell; step 0.015 m.

name: pie_slice_2
notes: One of 2 slices of a 0.12 m pie. Origin at the pie centre, slice points along +x; rotate by k*180.0 deg about y to assemble.

name: pie_slice_3
notes: One of 3 slices of a 0.12 m pie. Origin at the pie centre, slice points along +x; rotate by k*120.0 deg about y to assemble.

name: pie_slice_4
notes: One of 4 slices of a 0.12 m pie. Origin at the pie centre, slice points along +x; rotate by k*90.0 deg about y to assemble.

name: pie_slice_5
notes: One of 5 slices of a 0.12 m pie. Origin at the pie centre, slice points along +x; rotate by k*72.0 deg about y to assemble.

name: pie_slice_6
notes: One of 6 slices of a 0.12 m pie. Origin at the pie centre, slice points along +x; rotate by k*60.0 deg about y to assemble.

name: pie_slice_8
notes: One of 8 slices of a 0.12 m pie. Origin at the pie centre, slice points along +x; rotate by k*45.0 deg about y to assemble.

name: pie_slice_10
notes: One of 10 slices of a 0.12 m pie. Origin at the pie centre, slice points along +x; rotate by k*36.0 deg about y to assemble.

name: pie_slice_12
notes: One of 12 slices of a 0.12 m pie. Origin at the pie centre, slice points along +x; rotate by k*30.0 deg about y to assemble.

name: portal_main
notes: Stands upright on its feet at the edge of the book. ring_inner spins about z around the portal centre (0, 0.072, 0). spawn_anchor on the table just in front.

name: partner_window
notes: Floating frame, origin at its centre. view_anchor: centre of the opening (0.16 x 0.1 m) where the game renders the partner table; label_anchor above for the bot name.

name: help_orb_trail
notes: Origin at the head of the trail; it streams back along -x behind a flying help orb.

name: pip_owl
notes: Faces the player. label_anchor marks the speech bubble, up and to Pip's left. eyes_happy hidden by default.

name: great_crumple
notes: stage_1 is the outer shell (opens first), stage_3 the inner one. core (the tidy crane) rests at scale 0.001; unfold grows it. label_anchor_0..2 for the three numbers.

name: robot_partner_a
notes: Boxy robot, cobalt.

name: robot_partner_b
notes: Round robot on a wheel, teal.

name: robot_partner_c
notes: Tall robot on springs, orange.

name: skill_fraction_bridge_t1
notes: grow_* parts appear in order (deck, rails / arch / towers, cables).

name: skill_fraction_bridge_t2
notes: grow_* parts appear in order (deck, rails / arch / towers, cables).

name: skill_fraction_bridge_t3
notes: grow_* parts appear in order (deck, rails / arch / towers, cables).

name: skill_multiply_tower_t1
notes: floor_1..2 bottom to top, then roof.

name: skill_multiply_tower_t2
notes: floor_1..4 bottom to top, then roof.

name: skill_multiply_tower_t3
notes: floor_1..6 bottom to top, then roof.

name: skill_placevalue_hall_t1
notes: wing_center, then wing_left/right, then wing_dome at tier 3.

name: skill_placevalue_hall_t2
notes: wing_center, then wing_left/right, then wing_dome at tier 3.

name: skill_placevalue_hall_t3
notes: wing_center, then wing_left/right, then wing_dome at tier 3.

name: skill_decimal_market_t1
notes: stall_1..N (2, 4, 6) and a central stall_canopy at tier 3.

name: skill_decimal_market_t2
notes: stall_1..N (2, 4, 6) and a central stall_canopy at tier 3.

name: skill_decimal_market_t3
notes: stall_1..N (2, 4, 6) and a central stall_canopy at tier 3.

name: skill_measure_clocktower_t1
notes: hand_hour and hand_minute rotate about z around the clock centre; the face has 12 marks, no numbers.

name: skill_measure_clocktower_t2
notes: hand_hour and hand_minute rotate about z around the clock centre; the face has 12 marks, no numbers.

name: skill_measure_clocktower_t3
notes: hand_hour and hand_minute rotate about z around the clock centre; the face has 12 marks, no numbers.

name: town_page_grid
notes: Fits the right-hand page of popup_book at 0.03 m per tile. cell_origin = centre of the -x/-z corner cell; cells step 1 tile.

name: star
notes: Origin at the centre; faces +Z.

name: star_empty
notes: Paper outline of the same star (not yet earned).

name: badge_best_save
notes: Symbol only, no text. Origin at the disc centre; ribbon hangs below.

name: badge_most_improved
notes: Symbol only, no text. Origin at the disc centre; ribbon hangs below.

name: badge_sharpest_aim
notes: Symbol only, no text. Origin at the disc centre; ribbon hangs below.

name: badge_steady_streak
notes: Symbol only, no text. Origin at the disc centre; ribbon hangs below.

name: badge_brave_try
notes: Symbol only, no text. Origin at the disc centre; ribbon hangs below.

name: streak_shield
notes: Origin at the centre.

name: trophy_paper
notes: Stands on the table.

name: paper_button
notes: Poke from the front. press moves back along -z by up to 0.005 m; the game recolours sky.

name: paper_panel
notes: Background for recap and menu text drawn at label_anchor.

name: palm_menu_disc
notes: Faces +Z (towards the eyes when held up in the palm). slot_0 at the top, then clockwise.

name: confetti_pieces
notes: piece_0..11: squares, triangles, small stars and circles in the five mission colours, each with its origin at its centre.

name: paper_scraps
notes: scrap_0..5: gently bent torn pieces for a wrong answer (funny, not destructive).

name: fold_crease
notes: Shiny crease strip along x for fold animations; no ink outline.

name: sparkle
notes: Four-point sparkle, origin at the centre; no ink outline.
